From b6e32ba6d32503440a3e3e16c8d0521cbb7e0c5d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Aleksander Jan Bajkowski <olek2@wp.pl>
Date: Tue, 30 Dec 2025 22:17:17 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: inside-secure/eip93 - fix kernel panic in driver
 detach

During driver detach, the same hash algorithm is unregistered multiple
times due to a wrong iterator.

Fixes: 9739f5f93b78 ("crypto: eip93 - Add Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 crypto engine support")
Signed-off-by: Aleksander Jan Bajkowski <olek2@wp.pl>
Reviewed-by: Antoine Tenart <atenart@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/crypto/inside-secure/eip93/eip93-main.c b/drivers/crypto/inside-secure/eip93/eip93-main.c
index 0b38a567da0e..3cdc3308dcac 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/inside-secure/eip93/eip93-main.c
+++ b/drivers/crypto/inside-secure/eip93/eip93-main.c
@@ -90,7 +90,7 @@ static void eip93_unregister_algs(unsigned int i)
 			crypto_unregister_aead(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.aead);
 			break;
 		case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH:
-			crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash);
+			crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash);
 			break;
 		}
 	}
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Patch

### Modifications in each file

- **drivers/crypto/inside-secure/eip93/eip93-main.c**  
  In the `eip93_unregister_algs(unsigned int i)` function, the call to `crypto_unregister_ahash()` inside the `case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH:` branch was corrected from using the argument index `i` to the loop index `j`.  
  - **Before:** `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash);`  
  - **After:** `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash);`

### Relationship between modifications

The bug was caused by a typo where the loop iteration variable `j` was mistakenly replaced by the function parameter `i` when unregistering hash algorithms. The loop iterates over algorithms using `j` (from `0` to `i`), but the hash unregistration used the fixed outer index `i`, causing the same algorithm to be unregistered multiple times. This led to a kernel panic during driver detach. The one-line fix ensures that each hash algorithm is unregistered exactly once, using the correct loop index `j`.

crypto: inside-secure/eip93 - fix kernel panic in driver

times due to a wrong iterator.

Fixes: 9739f5f93b78 ("crypto: eip93 - Add Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 crypto engine support")
Signed-off-by: Aleksander Jan Bajkowski <olek2@wp.pl>
Reviewed-by: Antoine Tenart <atenart@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

Here is the root cause:
`), the code mistakenly used the function parameter `i` (the total count) instead of the loop index `j`. This caused the same hash algorithm (at index `i`, which is out of bounds or constant) to be unregistered multiple times, leading to a kernel panic during driver detach.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void eip93_unregister_algs(unsigned int i)
 {
 	unsigned int j;
 
 	for (j = 0; j < i; j++) {
 		switch (eip93_algs[j]->type) {
 		case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_SKCIPHER:
 			crypto_unregister_skcipher(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.skcipher);
 			break;
 		case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_AEAD:
 			crypto_unregister_aead(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.aead);
 			break;
 		case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH:
-			crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash);
+			crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash);
 			break;
 		}
 	}
 }
